classification: CURRENT_FACT throughout — derived by reading all 112 migrations and all 62 models.
scope: Every table in the current Marketplace database, its purpose, model, domain owner, keys, indexes, statuses, financial fields, timestamps, soft deletes, ownership, and its Creative relevance.

counts.foreign_key_definitions_note: 94 ->constrained() + 2 legacy ->foreign(); the earlier 91 in this artifact was an undercount

schema_conventions_observed.primary_key: Auto-incrementing unsigned bigint `id` on every table. No UUID primary keys anywhere.
schema_conventions_observed.money_type: DECIMAL. No integer minor-unit (paisa) columns. No float/double columns.
schema_conventions_observed.percentage_type: decimal(5,2) on split ratios; decimal(8,2) on commission percentages
schema_conventions_observed.status_type: VARCHAR string in almost all cases. Only two DB-level ENUMs remain (screens.status, screens.orientation). users.role was ENUM and was converted to VARCHAR by raw ALTER in 2026_07_10_000002.
schema_conventions_observed.timestamps: created_at + updated_at on all application tables, except booking_activities (UPDATED_AT = null — append-only by design)
schema_conventions_observed.soft_deletes: Only `screens` has deleted_at (migration 2026_11_03_000001) and only `Screen` uses the SoftDeletes trait. job_posts has a deleted_at column but its model does NOT use SoftDeletes — a silent trap.
schema_conventions_observed.polymorphism: personal_access_tokens (tokenable), activity_logs (entity_type/entity_id), notification_logs (recipient_type/recipient_id). None constrained at the DB level.
schema_conventions_observed.public_identifiers: booking_reference, screen_code, referral_codes.code, qr_codes.slug, screen_categories.slug, advertisement_categories.slug, products.slug, categories.slug, blog_tags.slug, screen_provider_settlements.reference_number. No UUIDs.
schema_conventions_observed.json_columns: bookings.pricing_snapshot, booking_screens.pricing_snapshot, booking_pricing_breakdowns.pricing_snapshot, screens.asset_metadata, products.ideal_for, activity_logs.old_values/new_values, notification_logs/payment_logs.metadata, booking_activities.metadata, screen_provider_activities.metadata, payments.metadata, refunds.metadata
schema_conventions_observed.indexing: Index coverage is inconsistent. Several high-traffic filter columns are unindexed — see missing_indexes below.
schema_conventions_observed.fulltext: ZERO fullText() indexes across all 112 migrations. All search is LIKE-based.

file_bearing_columns_without_a_central_f.statement: There is NO generic files / media / documents / attachments / uploads table. Every file is a bare path string in a feature-specific column.
file_bearing_columns_without_a_central_f.creative_implication: A creative file is commercially sensitive (brief attachments, source files, undelivered work). Storing it as a bare path string in a feature column, as this repository does everywhere, is unsafe. RECOMMENDATION: a creative_files table with disk, path, visibility, owner, size, mime, checksum and a public_id.
